description: Build script for running rialto unittests, including functions for building targets, running tests with optional valgrind and coverage, and generating coverage reports.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to parse arguments and orchestrate build and test execution.

methods.name: buildTargets
methods.description: Builds the test executables using cmake and make, with optional coverage.

methods.name: runTests
methods.description: Runs the specified test suites with optional valgrind and coverage, handling test filtering and output.

methods.name: AddValgrind
methods.description: Constructs the valgrind command with appropriate options for leak checking and suppression.

methods.name: generateCoverageReport
methods.description: Generates code coverage reports using lcov and genhtml, and creates a summary statistics file.
